Subject: OneTrust sync errors — missing CAIQ claims after weekly import

Hi Rachel,

Quick note from our side: after the nightly OneTrust import last night we can see most answers from the CAIQ mapping are present in the portal, but ~18% of the mapped claims show as 'unanswered' in OneTrust and Whistic preview. The log snippet shows repeated 403s on GET to the S3 presigned URLs used by your ingestion pipeline.

Attached: ot-sync-logs.zip (contains 1k lines from 2027-05-13 22:00 to 2027-05-14 03:00 UTC), and a screenshot of the portal state (ot-sync-error-screenshot.png). We're blocked on completing our vendor attestation for a customer audit — can you advise root cause and ETA?

Appreciate any quick triage.

Andy Sullivan

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Andy Sullivan <andy.sullivan@heliodata.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: OneTrust sync errors — missing CAIQ claims after weekly import

Quick triage notes (short):
- Confirmed: our ingestion lambda returned 403s when fetching presigned objects from S3 during the 2027-05-13 22:00 to 2027-05-14 03:00 UTC window. Logs match the ot-sync-logs.zip Andy attached.
- Root cause: a scheduled key rotation job (internal-cicd/credential-rotation) ran at 2027-05-13T21:55Z and rotated the IAM credentials used by the OneTrust presign service. The new role binding is correct but an IAM policy step was accidentally skipped in the rotation pipeline (policy attach step failed intermittently). Result: service principal could still generate presigned URLs but the short-lived STS creds used by the worker to GET the objects lacked s3:GetObject for a subset of the objects stored under the archived prefix (archive/2027/05/13/*).
- Why partial: archive objects are read via a separate role (archive-read-role) that didn't get the s3:GetObject permission attached due to a timing/race condition in our policy attach orchestration. New objects after the rotation are fine.

Immediate remediation I pushed (temporary):
1) Re-applied s3:GetObject to archive-read-role (2027-05-14T10:38Z) 
2) Restarted the ingestion workers and requeued failed jobs (started 10:45Z).
3) Replayed the 2027-05-13 archive fetch with a limited canary (30 objects) — all succeeded.

Remaining actions:
- Roll a patch to the rotation pipeline where we add a deterministic post-attach verify step (I prepared patch.diff and linked to SEC-2314).
- Schedule a controlled rotation re-run after verification (window proposed below).

ETA for full reconciliation: re-run of backlog population and verification should complete by 2027-05-15 16:00Z if no further errors. I'll post updates to SEC-2314.

Jonas Weber
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Andy Sullivan <andy.sullivan@heliodata.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:19:00 -0400
Subject: Re: OneTrust sync errors — missing CAIQ claims after weekly import

Thanks Jonas — I reviewed the rotation pipeline logs and the post-attach verification indeed had a transient error that we didn't bubble as fatal. I opened PR #4279 that:
- Adds an explicit IAM policy readback and validate step after attach (so attach failures fail the rotation),
- Adds retry/backoff for attach operations against the org's IAM API,
- Adds a health-check that asserts archive-read-role has s3:GetObject for the archived prefix before we mark rotation complete.

I've attached patch.diff (small) and will push the change to staging today. Plan:
- Deploy to staging and run a simulated rotation job (no impact to production) — target: 2027-05-15 02:00Z staging run.
- If green, schedule a constrained production rotation on 2027-05-16 01:00Z with an immediate rollback trigger.

For the backlog, Jonas' replay fixed the immediate 30-object canary; I'll kick off a parallel replay using two workers to clear the remaining ~2.1k objects — expected finish 2027-05-15 15:30Z.

I'll post PR link and staging logs to SEC-2314.

Camila Reyes
SRE, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Andy — quick update and timeline: 
- Root cause: a rotation pipeline hiccup (missing post-attach verification) caused archive-read-role to temporarily lack s3:GetObject on archived objects; this produced partial 403s during HelioData's import.
- Remediation: Jonas reapplied permission and restarted workers; Camila pushed a patch to add verification and retries. Patch is in staging and PR is linked from SEC-2314.
- Backlog reconciliation: replay is underway; expected to finish by 2027-05-15 15:30Z (we completed successfully at 15:22Z). All previously-unanswered claims for HelioData now show answered in OneTrust.
- Next steps: schedule controlled rotation (2027-05-16 01:00Z) with rollback plan; we will notify HelioData 30 minutes before the rotation and confirm post-rotation integrity.

Marissa will follow up with a brief customer message. Irene: can you sign off on the communication copy?

Thank you for the quick heads-up and patience — we know audits are time sensitive. Apologies for the disruption.

Warmly,
Rachel
